_note: Bands the owner has confirmed (include) or keeps out (exclude). Included bands' official full concerts are accepted even when the classifier is unsure; their genres here are used when the classifier gives none of ours. allConcerts: true puts the band in the per-artist lane (scripts/artist-lane.ts). The top-90 list from festival line-ups is added in step 6 of the brief. Excluded bands are never published, whatever the source. Names are matched ignoring case, accents and symbols; add other spellings to 'aka'.
